ACKRGPGSGFFSRLN is a linear peptidic epitope (epitope ID 570) studied as part of Hemagglutinin (UniProt:P03452) from Influenza A virus.  This epitope has been studied for immune reactivity in 2 publication(s), tested in 4 T cell assays and 7 B cell assays.

A: H25, H45, V46, N47, L496, S306, L307, P308, T333; B: D363, G364, W365, Q382, T385, Q386, I389, D390, T393, V396, N397, I400; is a discontinuous epitope (epitope ID 226309) studied as part of Two components:Hemagglutinin (UniProt:P03452) & Hemagglutinin (UniProt:P03452) from Influenza A virus.  This epitope has been studied for immune reactivity in 4 publication(s), tested in 12 B cell assays and has 3D structure(s) 3gbn.
